title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 5,701–5,750 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 法式傳統歐式工藝烘焙坊；麵包店

examples.en: The Parisian artisan boulangerie fills early morning streets with the scent of freshly baked sourdough baguettes.
examples.zh: 巴黎街頭的傳統法式工藝麵包坊，清晨讓剛出爐的酸種長棍麵包香氣飄滿整條巷弄。

examples.en: Locals line up outside the neighborhood boulangerie before seven o'clock every morning.
examples.zh: 當地居民每天清晨七點不到，便在社區傳統麵包坊門口大排長龍等候新鮮出爐的麵包。

examples.en: This authentic French boulangerie uses imported stone-ground flour and heirloom sourdough starters.
examples.zh: 這家道地的法式麵包工坊堅持採用法國原裝進口石磨麵粉與傳承數十年的老麵起種。

words.definition: 天然野生酵母酸種老麵 (起種酵頭)

examples.en: Cultivating a wild yeast levain starter with whole rye flour infuses bread with complex aromatic flavors.
examples.zh: 用全粒黑麥粉細心餵養天然野生酵母老麵種，能為麵包注入豐富深沉的多層次果香與麥香。

examples.en: The baker feeds his active levain twice daily with equal parts organic flour and filtered water.
examples.zh: 麵包師每天以等比例的有機麵粉與過濾水，早晚各餵養一次充滿活力的天然老麵酵頭。

examples.en: A ripe levain passes the float test when a spoonful gently bobs on the surface of room-temperature water.
examples.zh: 當挖出一匙發酵成熟的天然酵頭輕盈漂浮在常溫水面上時，便確認已達到最佳起種活性。

words.definition: 舊金山天然酸種麵包；酸麵團

examples.en: A proper loaf of sourdough requires only three simple ingredients: unbleached flour, pure water, and salt.
examples.zh: 一顆完美的天然酸種麵包，僅需未漂白小麥麵粉、純淨水與海鹽三種純粹原料即可烘烤而成。

examples.en: Long fermentation breaks down gluten structures, making artisan sourdough easier on sensitive stomachs.
examples.zh: 長達數十小時的緩慢發酵能分解麩質大分子，讓工藝酸種麵包更易於腸胃消化吸收。

examples.en: Toasting thick slices of sourdough unlocks deep caramel notes and a pleasant acidic tang.
examples.zh: 將厚切酸種麵包片烘烤至金黃，能激發出深層的焦糖麥香與迷人回甘的微酸風味。

words.definition: 80% 高含水量麵團比例；水合度

examples.en: High hydration dough at eighty percent creates a tender, custard-like crumb packed with open air pockets.
examples.zh: 高達百分之八十的高含水量麵團，能烤出外脆內潤、如布丁般濕潤 Q 彈的大氣孔組織。

examples.en: Handling sticky dough with high hydration requires practiced hand techniques and wet bench knives.
examples.zh: 操作高含水量的黏手麵團，需要純熟的推拉手感以及沾濕的刮板輔助操作。

examples.en: Novice bakers often start with sixty-five percent hydration before tackling wetter mixtures.
examples.zh: 初學烘焙新手通常建議先從百分之六十五的中度水合開始練習，再逐步挑戰高含水麵團。

words.definition: 麵粉與水預先水解自溶靜置工序

examples.en: Allowing flour and water to autolyse for sixty minutes relaxes proteins, making subsequent kneading effortless.
examples.zh: 將麵粉與水混合均勻水解自溶靜置一小時，能軟化小麥蛋白質，讓後續揉麵輕鬆出筋。

examples.en: Adding salt only after the autolyse phase prevents tightening gluten too early in the mixing process.
examples.zh: 堅持在水解自溶工序結束後才加入海鹽，能避免麵筋過早緊繃收縮影響延展。

examples.en: During autolyse, natural enzymes activate and convert starches into fermentable simple sugars.
examples.zh: 在麵粉自溶水解期間，天然酵素被充分活化，將小麥澱粉分解轉化為酵母所需的發酵糖分。

words.definition: 盆內折疊拉伸手法 (取代劇烈揉麵)

examples.en: Gentle coil folds and stretch-and-fold kneading develop strong gluten networks without tiring the baker.
examples.zh: 採用溫和的盆內拉伸折疊取代傳統劇烈揉麵，在省力中培養出強韌麵筋。

examples.en: Traditional vigorous countertop kneading is unnecessary when using time and moisture to develop structure.
examples.zh: 當善用時間與水分子自然化合形成麵筋骨架時，大汗淋漓的傳統揉麵其實完全多餘。

examples.en: Overly aggressive mechanical kneading can oxidize dough and bleach out vibrant carotenoid flavors.
examples.zh: 過度激烈的攪拌機高速揉麵會讓麵團過度氧化，甚至漂白流失麵粉中寶貴的天然胡蘿蔔素麥香。

words.definition: 麵筋薄膜擴展測試 (手套膜)；麩質

examples.en: Stretching a small piece of dough to see if it forms a translucent gluten windowpane confirms optimal mixing.
examples.zh: 輕輕拉開一小塊麵團進行手套膜薄膜測試，能確認麵筋是否達到最佳延展擴展階段。

examples.en: High-protein bread flour contains the gluten potential needed to hold expanding yeast gases.
examples.zh: 高筋小麥麵粉蘊含充沛的優質麩質潛力，能形成堅固網狀氣囊以支撐酵母產生的二氧化碳。

examples.en: If the gluten network tears prematurely during the windowpane test, the dough requires further folding.
examples.zh: 若在薄膜拉伸測試中麵膜過早破裂產生鋸齒缺口，代表麵筋結構仍需進一步折疊強化。

words.definition: 24 小時低溫冷藏初次主發酵；體積

examples.en: Cold bulk fermentation inside a 4°C refrigerator allows lactic acid bacteria to develop deep sourdough complexity.
examples.zh: 在四度低溫冰箱中進行長達二十四小時的冷藏主發酵，讓乳酸菌充分發酵出迷人風味。

examples.en: The baker watches for a fifty percent volume increase to judge when bulk fermentation is finished.
examples.zh: 烘焙師密切觀察麵團膨脹約五成體積的關鍵指標，以精準判斷初次主發酵是否圓滿成熟。

examples.en: Bubbles visible through clear plastic tubs indicate healthy gas production during bulk rise.
examples.zh: 從透明發酵保鮮盒側面觀察到密集的微小氣泡，代表麵團在初發階段產氣旺盛健康。

words.definition: 圓形藤編發酵籃最後整形發酵

examples.en: Resting shaped dough inside a floured cane banneton proofing basket imprints lovely spiral ridges onto the crust.
examples.zh: 將整形好的麵團放入灑有米粉的藤編發酵籃中最後發酵，能在外皮留下優雅的螺旋粉紋。

examples.en: Retarding the final proofing overnight in a cold retarder deepens crust color and enhances blisters.
examples.zh: 將整形後的麵團放入低溫發酵箱中進行隔夜後發酵，能加深外殼金黃色澤並催生誘人氣泡。

examples.en: Poke the dough gently with a floured index finger; if it springs back slowly, proofing is optimal.
examples.zh: 用沾粉食指輕壓麵團表面；若凹洞緩慢回彈並留有微痕，代表最後發酵恰到好處。

words.definition: 割線剃刀劃開麵包頂部脆耳刻痕

examples.en: Precise angled scoring with a sharp razor blade allows steam to escape, producing a prominent crispy ear.
examples.zh: 用鋒利的割線刀在麵團表面進行精準斜切割線劃痕，能引導蒸氣爆發並烤出金黃挺立的脆耳。

examples.en: Without proper surface scoring, the expanding loaf may rupture awkwardly along the bottom rim.
examples.zh: 若未在表面劃出導引出氣孔的割線，急速膨脹的麵包很可能在底部側邊產生醜陋爆裂。

examples.en: Intricate decorative scoring transforms everyday rustic loaves into stunning works of edible art.
examples.zh: 繁複華麗的麥穗與藤蔓幾何裝飾性割線，能將質樸的鄉村麵包昇華為令人驚嘆的餐桌藝術品。

words.definition: 麵包師專用弧形割線剃刀 (Lame)

examples.en: The master baker grips his curved lame razor swiftly, slashing curved crescent moons across the loaf top.
examples.zh: 烘焙大師手握專用弧形割線剃刀，在麵團表面行雲流水般劃下一道道優美的一彎新月弧線。

examples.en: Changing dull blades on the wooden handle lame ensures clean incisions that do not drag on wet dough.
examples.zh: 定期為原木握柄割線刀更換鋒利刀片，能確保刀口乾淨俐落而不拖泥帶水拉扯濕麵團。

examples.en: Holding the lame at a thirty-degree angle creates the classic flap that lifts into a crispy ear.
examples.zh: 將割線刀傾斜三十度角劃入麵團表皮，能形成一片翻卷外翹的薄皮，進而在高溫中烤出香脆立耳。

words.definition: 烤箱入爐高溫蒸氣膨脹爆發力；春天

examples.en: Trapping high-pressure steam inside the hot Dutch oven generates explosive oven spring during the first 20 minutes.
examples.zh: 在滾燙鑄鐵鍋內鎖住高壓水蒸氣，在入爐前二十分鐘激發出驚人的烤箱入爐膨脹力。

examples.en: A well-fermented sourdough exhibits remarkable vertical spring when baked on a preheated pizza stone.
examples.zh: 發酵成熟度絕佳的酸種麵團，在放上預熱充分的披薩石板烘烤時會展現驚人的向上拔高爆發力。

examples.en: Insufficient yeast vitality or overproofing results in a flat loaf that lacks proper oven spring.
examples.zh: 若酵母活力衰退或後發過度耗盡糖分，烤出的麵包將扁塌下陷，完全喪失入爐膨脹力。

words.definition: 焦香酥脆金黃脆皮外殼 (帶微氣泡)

examples.en: The dark golden blistered crust crackles loudly with a hollow thud when tapped with a knuckle.
examples.zh: 烤至深金黃色、帶有細小酥脆氣泡的麵包外皮，用指節輕敲時發出清脆響亮的空洞聲響。

examples.en: Generous steam injection during the initial bake phase keeps the crust flexible so it can expand fully.
examples.zh: 入爐前段灌注充沛蒸氣能延緩外皮結殼硬化，給予麵包充分舒展伸張的黃金時間。

examples.en: Connoisseurs prize the smoky bitterness of an artisan loaf’s deeply caramelized dark mahogany crust.
examples.zh: 真正懂麵包的老饕最迷戀那烤至深紅褐色的焦脆外殼，品嚐其微苦回甘的純粹焦糖香。

words.definition: 蜂巢狀大氣孔柔軟內部麵包心組織

examples.en: Slicing the cooled loaf reveals an open, airy honeycomb crumb glistening with natural moisture.
examples.zh: 待麵包完全放涼後俐落切開，展現出如蜂巢般大氣孔開闊、泛著絲綢般水亮光澤的內部組織。

examples.en: Gentle shaping preserves gas pockets so the crumb structure remains open rather than dense.
examples.zh: 溫柔輕巧的最後整形手法能完整保留發酵氣室，使烤出的麵包心呈現開闊而非緊實死硬。

examples.en: A gummy, wet crumb usually indicates underbaking or cutting the loaf before it completely cooled down.
examples.zh: 若切開時麵包內部呈現黏牙濕潤的口感，通常代表烘烤時間不足或是尚未放涼便急躁下刀。

words.definition: 維也納可頌千層酥皮甜點麵包類

examples.en: High-end hotels pride themselves on serving warm, flaky viennoiserie freshly baked at dawn.
examples.zh: 五星級飯店早餐以供應清晨現烤出爐、層次分明且香氣撲鼻的法式可頌千層甜麵包為傲。

examples.en: The apprentice practiced folding pain au chocolat and Danish twists until mastering viennoiserie techniques.
examples.zh: 烘焙學徒反覆練習折疊巧克力千層麵包與丹麥肉桂捲，直到徹底精通各類維也納酥皮麵包技法。

examples.en: Authentic viennoiserie bridges the gap between bread baking and fine pastry making.
examples.zh: 正統維也納千層烘焙巧妙搭起了傳統主食麵包與奢華精緻甜點之間的金色橋樑。

words.definition: 蜂巢氣孔十六層法式經典奶油可頌

examples.en: Biting into a pristine French butter croissant yields an audible crunch followed by rich melting butter.
examples.zh: 輕輕咬下一口剛出爐的法式經典奶油可頌，先是一聲清脆酥響，隨即迎來濃郁發酵奶油的融化香氣。

examples.en: Slicing a cross-section of a high-quality croissant displays a flawless, uniform honeycomb interior structure.
examples.zh: 橫切剖開一顆頂級可頌，斷面展現出如精密蜂巢般均勻舒展、薄如蟬翼的氣孔網狀結構。

examples.en: She enjoyed dunking the tip of her warm croissant into a bowl of cafe au lait at the corner bistro.
examples.zh: 她最喜歡坐在轉角露天小酒館，將剛出爐的溫暖可頌尖角輕輕沾著香濃法式歐蕾咖啡品嚐。

words.definition: 奶油裹油折疊開酥壓延工藝

examples.en: Perfect butter tourage lamination encloses paper-thin layers of chilled cultured butter between delicate sheets of dough.
examples.zh: 頂級開酥裹油折疊工藝，將冰涼發酵奶油片均勻包裹在麵團層中，反覆三折出數十層黃金酥皮。

examples.en: Keeping dough cold between turns prevents butter from melting into the flour during lamination.
examples.zh: 在每次折疊開酥工序之間將麵團送入冷藏降溫，能徹底防止奶油因室溫融化而滲入麵粉。

examples.en: Modern bakeries use automated dough sheeters to maintain millimeter consistency throughout the lamination process.
examples.zh: 現代精品烘焙坊引進精密自動壓麵機，在裹油延壓全程確保酥皮厚薄達到毫米級的一致性。

words.definition: 濃郁奶香法式布里歐修金黃吐司

examples.en: Enriched with eighty percent European butter and golden egg yolks, brioche toast melts like velvet on the tongue.
examples.zh: 奢侈揉入高達八成天然發酵奶油與新鮮蛋黃的法式布里歐修，在舌尖展現如絲絨般化開的濃郁奶香。

examples.en: Thick slices of day-old brioche make the most decadent, custard-soaked French toast imaginable.
examples.zh: 將隔夜的厚切布里歐修吐司浸透香草蛋奶液煎烤，能製成極致香濃、入口即化的頂級法式吐司。

examples.en: The baker kneads butter into the brioche dough slowly until the mixture becomes silky and elastic.
examples.zh: 烘焙師以極度耐心分次將軟化奶油揉進布里歐麵團中，直到整體麵團呈現絲緞般的延展光澤。

words.definition: 高級法式精緻藝術甜點店；甜點工藝

examples.en: The glass vitrine of the luxury patisserie glitters with colorful jewel-like fruit tarts and layered cakes.
examples.zh: 高級法式甜點店的恆溫玻璃展示櫃中，整齊陳列著如珠寶般璀璨奪目的水果塔與精緻蛋糕。

examples.en: French patisserie requires absolute chemical precision in temperature, weight, and timing.
examples.zh: 傳統法式高級甜點工藝在溫度控制、原料重量與烘焙秒數上，有著近乎化學實驗般的絕對精準。

examples.en: Tourists flocked to the renowned patisserie to sample award-winning Saint-Honoré and chocolate eclairs.
examples.zh: 絡繹不絕的觀光客慕名湧入這家傳奇甜點名店，爭相朝聖得獎的聖多諾黑泡芙塔與閃電泡芙。

words.definition: 法芙娜頂級純黑巧克力絲滑甘納許

examples.en: Emulsifying hot heavy cream into melted dark chocolate creates a silky, mirror-glossy chocolate ganache.
examples.zh: 將滾燙鮮奶油緩慢均勻乳化進融化的純黑巧克力中，調配出絲滑細膩、泛著鏡面光澤的甘納許。

examples.en: The pastry chef whipped chilled passionfruit ganache into an ethereal filling for chocolate tarts.
examples.zh: 甜點主廚將冰鎮後的百香果黑巧甘納許快速打發，製成口感輕盈如羽毛般的巧克力塔內餡。

examples.en: Controlling the emulsion temperature prevents ganache from splitting or becoming grainy.
examples.zh: 嚴格掌控乳化攪拌的溫度區間，能徹底避免甘納許發生油水分離或產生顆粒沙感的敗筆。

words.definition: 巧克力精準控溫調溫工藝 (形成結晶)

examples.en: Precise chocolate tempering forms stable beta crystals, giving molded pralines a sharp snap and satin shine.
examples.zh: 經過精準升溫降溫的巧克力調溫工藝，能形成最穩定的結晶體，賦予巧克力脆口斷裂聲與緞面光澤。

examples.en: If chocolate tempering is rushed, dull white cocoa butter blooms will ruin the confection's glossy finish.
examples.zh: 若調溫過程操之過急溫度失控，巧克力表面冷卻後會浮現難看的白色可可脂白霜與消光斑痕。

examples.en: Artisans temper liquid chocolate on cold marble slabs using wide stainless steel palette knives.
examples.zh: 巧克力工藝師手持寬幅不鏽鋼抹刀，在大理石冷石板上反覆推抹翻拌以完成調溫結晶。

words.definition: 焦糖香脆榛果巴芮脆片夾心 (Praline)

examples.en: The chef layered crunchy hazelnut praline inside the chocolate mousse to provide delightful textural contrast.
examples.zh: 主廚在濃郁巧克力慕斯底層鋪上一層香脆的焦糖榛果脆片，在口中帶來驚豔的酥脆層次感。

examples.en: Crushed caramelized almond praline adds an addictive crunch to filled artisan bonbons.
examples.zh: 撒入碎粒焦糖杏仁脆片，能為手工夾心夾心巧克力球增添令人欲罷不能的香脆嚼感。

examples.en: Grinding roasted nuts with caramelized sugar on stone mills produces smooth, aromatic praline paste.
examples.zh: 將現烤堅果與琥珀焦糖送入石磨機中慢速細磨，能提煉出香氣四溢、絲滑濃郁的堅果巴芮醬。

words.definition: 少女酥胸雙色法式杏仁馬卡龍

examples.en: The pastel-pink rose macaron boasts a delicate crisp shell with a chewy almond meringue center.
examples.zh: 散發夢幻淡粉色澤的玫瑰法式馬卡龍，擁有外層酥脆、內裡濕潤黏韌的迷人杏仁蛋白霜裙邊。

examples.en: Baking a successful macaron requires letting piped batter dry until a dull skin forms on top.
examples.zh: 成功烘烤馬卡龍的關鍵竅門，在於擠出圓形麵糊後必須靜置結皮，直到表面觸摸不黏手方可入爐。

examples.en: Each box contained twelve colorful macarons ranging from salted caramel to black currant flavors.
examples.zh: 精裝禮盒中整齊排列著十二顆繽紛馬卡龍，口味從海鹽焦糖到酸甜黑醋栗一應俱全。

words.definition: 義式熱糖漿打發光亮硬挺蛋白霜

examples.en: Whipping boiling sugar syrup into egg whites produces glossy, cloud-like Italian meringue that holds stiff peaks.
examples.zh: 將滾燙高溫糖漿細流緩緩注入打發蛋白中，打出如雲朵般光亮白皙且硬挺不塌的義式蛋白霜。

examples.en: A blowtorch was used to lightly scorch the swirled meringue topping the lemon pie.
examples.zh: 烘焙師手持噴槍微微炙烤檸檬派頂端的蛋白霜波浪紋路，烙上迷人誘人的焦糖虎斑色澤。

examples.en: Slow drying in a low-temperature oven yields brittle, feather-light meringue kisses.
examples.zh: 放入低溫烤箱長時間烘乾脫水，能製作出入口即化、香甜酥脆如羽毛般的法式蛋白霜小餅乾。

words.definition: 菠蘿脆皮法式修女泡芙 (泡芙麵糊)

examples.en: Topping choux pastry with a disc of craquelin cookie dough yields perfectly round, ultra-crispy cream puffs.
examples.zh: 在法式泡芙麵糊頂端覆蓋一片菠蘿酥皮，進爐烘烤出圓滾滾、外皮極致酥脆的修女泡芙。

examples.en: The choux dough must be cooked thoroughly on the stove to gelatinize flour starches before adding eggs.
examples.zh: 泡芙生麵團入爐前必須先在鍋中充分受熱燙熟，使麵粉澱粉徹底糊化後方可分次攪入全蛋液。

examples.en: Steam generated inside the hollow choux buns during baking creates the cavity for cream fillings.
examples.zh: 烘烤時泡芙內部水分蒸發產生強大水蒸氣，撐開中空的大氣孔內腔，以容納香濃飽滿的卡士達醬。

words.definition: 經典法式長條閃電泡芙 (卡士達內餡)

examples.en: Filled with rich Madagascar vanilla bean custard, the shiny chocolate eclair is a beloved French tea treat.
examples.zh: 灌滿香濃馬達加斯加香草卡士達醬、表面淋上晶亮黑巧克力的長條閃電泡芙，是下午茶的絕配。

examples.en: The baker piped an even baton of choux dough onto perforated silicone mats to ensure straight eclairs.
examples.zh: 麵包師以鋸齒花嘴在透氣矽膠烤墊上擠出筆直均勻的長條泡芙糊，確保烘烤時不彎曲變形。

examples.en: Dipping the surface into mirror-like dark chocolate icing gives the eclair its glossy signature finish.
examples.zh: 將金黃酥脆的泡芙表面輕巧沾上一層鏡面黑巧克力淋醬，為閃電泡芙賦予招牌的耀眼光澤。

words.definition: 焦糖酥脆千層酥拿破崙蛋糕

examples.en: The classic mille-feuille layers three sheets of caramelized puff pastry with silky diplomat pastry cream.
examples.zh: 享譽世界的法式千層酥拿破崙，由三層烤至香脆焦糖化的千層酥皮夾著香滑卡士達慕斯。

examples.en: Slicing through a delicate mille-feuille requires a sharp serrated knife to avoid crushing the layers.
examples.zh: 分切結構精細脆弱的千層酥蛋糕時，必須使用特製鋒利鋸齒刀如拉鋸般輕剖以防壓扁壓裂酥皮。

examples.en: The traditional top icing of a mille-feuille features a white fondant glaze with elegant feathered chocolate stripes.
examples.zh: 傳統拿破崙千層頂部會淋上一層白色糖霜翻糖，並以竹籤拉花勾勒出典雅的羽狀巧克力紋路。

words.definition: 法式黃檸檬凝乳蛋白霜甜塔；酸的

examples.en: The refreshing lemon meringue tart balances zesty, sour lemon curd with sweet toasted meringue tips.
examples.zh: 這款經典的法式檸檬塔，以酸香濃郁的現榨黃檸檬凝乳完美中和了微炙蛋白霜的香甜。

examples.en: Seasonal strawberries glazed with red currant jelly sat atop the almond cream tart base.
examples.zh: 刷上薄薄紅醋栗果凍光澤膠的新鮮當季草莓，整齊簇擁盛裝在濃郁的杏仁奶油甜塔皮底座上。

examples.en: The chef created a savory heirloom tomato tart garnished with aged balsamic glaze and goat cheese.
examples.zh: 主廚巧具匠心地端出一款經典傳家寶番茄鹹塔，佐以陳年巴薩米克酒醋與新鮮山羊乳酪。

words.definition: 酥脆法式沙布列奶油甜塔皮 (Pâte Sablée)

examples.en: Blind baking the buttery pâte sablée crust ensures it stays crisp even after being filled with juicy berries.
examples.zh: 將散發濃郁發酵奶油香氣的沙布列塔皮預先盲烤至金黃，能確保填入新鮮莓果後依然維持酥脆。

examples.en: Rubbing cold butter cubes into flour until it resembles sandy breadcrumbs is the secret to tender pâte sablée.
examples.zh: 用手指指腹將冰涼奶油丁與麵粉搓磨成細砂質地，是烤出酥鬆化口沙布列塔皮的不二秘訣。

examples.en: Perforated tart rings allow steam to escape, keeping sablée tart shells razor-sharp and flat.
examples.zh: 搭配透氣微孔塔圈盲烤能讓水氣全面逸散，使出爐的沙布列塔殼邊角俐落垂直、平整不縮水。

words.definition: 絲絨般輕盈滑順之法式冷藏慕斯

examples.en: The velvety white chocolate matcha mousse dissolves effortlessly on the palate with a refreshing green tea finish.
examples.zh: 這款如絲絨般輕盈綿密的白巧克力抹茶慕斯，入口即化並在唇齒間留下回甘悠長的高雅茶香。

examples.en: Folding whipped cream gently into the warm fruit puree preserves the light, airy texture of the mousse.
examples.zh: 將打發至六分發的鮮奶油輕柔切拌入溫熱果泥中，能完好留住慕斯輕盈如雲朵般的細緻質地。

examples.en: Dark chocolate mousse chilled in crystal dessert cups makes a timeless dinner party finale.
examples.zh: 盛裝在精緻水晶杯中冰鎮冷藏的純黑巧克力慕斯，是任何星級晚宴歷久不衰的終極甜點句點。

words.definition: 星空鏡面淋面 (倒影出清晰光澤)；淋醬

examples.en: Pouring a purple galaxy mirror glaze over the chilled entremet creates an astonishing, glass-like reflection.
examples.zh: 將調溫至三十三度的紫色星空鏡面淋面均勻淋在冰凍慕斯蛋糕上，呈現出倒映出人影的晶亮光澤。

examples.en: Temperature is paramount; if the chocolate glaze is poured too hot, it will melt the underlying mousse.
examples.zh: 淋面溫度掌控至關重要；若巧克力淋醬溫度過高，會瞬間融化並沖塌底層脆弱的冷卻慕斯。

examples.en: A clear pectin glaze brushed over fresh kiwi slices prevents oxidation while giving an appetizing shine.
examples.zh: 在新鮮奇異果切片上薄薄刷上一層天然蘋果膠晶亮果凍膠，既能防止果肉氧化又能增添垂涎光彩。

words.definition: 多層次法式現代冷藏精緻慕斯蛋糕

examples.en: Cutting into the modern entremets reveals five harmonious layers of sponge, crunchy praline, fruit coulis, and mousse.
examples.zh: 切開精緻的法式現代慕斯蛋糕，剖面展現出海綿蛋糕、榛果脆片、水果庫利與慕斯五重奏。

examples.en: Crafting an award-winning entremets requires hours of precision assembly using silicone molds and blast chillers.
examples.zh: 製作一款奪得國際甜點金牌的頂級法式慕斯蛋糕，需要藉由矽膠模具與急凍冷鏈耗時數日精準拼裝。

examples.en: Each slice of the gourmet entremets offers an interplay of acidity, sweetness, crunch, and creaminess.
examples.zh: 每一口頂級法式慕斯切片，都在唇齒間交織出酸甜平衡、酥脆與絲滑的極致味蕾協奏曲。

words.definition: 酸甜現熬覆盆子紅醋栗果凍庫利夾心

examples.en: A tart raspberry fruit coulis insert cuts through the richness of the dark chocolate mousse.
examples.zh: 蛋糕核心包入一層酸爽甜美的天然覆盆子果凍庫利夾心，能完美化解純黑巧克力的濃郁厚重感。

examples.en: The chef simmered ripe mangoes and passion fruit to create a vibrant tropical coulis sauce.
examples.zh: 主廚將熟透的愛文芒果與埔里百香果文火細熬，調配出酸甜濃郁、充滿陽光風情的熱帶水果庫利。

examples.en: Gelatin sets the fruit coulis into a firm disc that can be easily centered inside the cake mold.
examples.zh: 添加微量吉利丁凝固水果庫利果泥，使其凝結成厚度平整的圓形夾層凍，便於精準嵌入慕斯中央。

words.definition: 柔軟蓬鬆杏仁海綿蛋糕體 (Joconde)；海綿

examples.en: Baked with finely ground almond flour, the thin Joconde sponge cake provides structural support without heaviness.
examples.zh: 採用純杏仁粉烘烤而成的法式杏仁海綿蛋糕，質地輕盈蓬鬆且具備支撐多層慕斯的優雅結構。

examples.en: Soaking the vanilla sponge with coffee liqueur syrup infuses moisture and deep flavor into the dessert.
examples.zh: 在香草海綿蛋糕胚上刷滿濃郁的咖啡利口香甜酒糖液，為蛋糕體注入豐沛濕潤度與深層香氣。

examples.en: The airy genoise sponge relies on whipped whole eggs rather than chemical baking powder to rise.
examples.zh: 輕柔蓬鬆的全蛋海綿蛋糕全靠全蛋隔水打發的細緻氣泡支撐膨脹，絕不添加任何化學泡打粉。

words.definition: 甜點風味滴管 (注入君度橙酒或糖漿)

examples.en: Guests squeeze the tiny liqueur pipette inserted into the pastry to infuse orange brandy just before eating.
examples.zh: 品嚐甜點前，賓客親手擠壓插在蛋糕上的微型風味滴管，將君度橙酒瞬間注入蛋糕核心增添香氣。

examples.en: Adding a mini espresso pipette to the dessert plate lets diners customize their tiramisu's intensity.
examples.zh: 在甜點盤上附上一支迷你義式濃縮咖啡滴管，能讓饕客隨心所欲調整提拉米蘇的咖啡濃郁濃度。

examples.en: The pipette prevents alcohol from making the delicate sponge cake soggy before presentation.
examples.zh: 運用風味調味滴管能在出餐上桌前將酒液獨立封存，避免精緻的海綿蛋糕因久放而過度吸水浸濕軟爛。

words.definition: 香草莢與伯爵茶高溫鮮奶浸泡萃取

examples.en: Slow hot milk infusion extracts the floral essential oils from whole Earl Grey tea leaves.
examples.zh: 將整片皇家伯爵茶葉放入滾燙鮮奶中進行低溫慢速浸泡萃取，完美提煉出天然佛手柑芬芳香氣。

examples.en: Overnight cold infusion of roasted coffee beans in dairy cream creates a fragrant ganache base.
examples.zh: 將現磨中深焙咖啡豆浸泡在頂級鮮奶油中低溫冷萃隔夜，能調配出風味層次絕佳的甘納許多酚基底。

examples.en: Steeping crushed cardamom and mint leaves created an aromatic herbal infusion for summer fruit tarts.
examples.zh: 將拍碎的綠荳蔻與新鮮薄荷葉投入鮮乳浸泡萃取，為初夏水果塔注入一股沁人心脾的草本清香。

words.definition: 馬達加斯加波旁天然頂級香草莢

examples.en: Splitting a plump Madagascar bourbon vanilla bean releases thousands of fragrant black caviar-like seeds.
examples.zh: 剖開一根飽滿油亮的馬達加斯加天然香草莢，刮出數以萬計如黑魚子醬般香甜芬芳的香草籽。

examples.en: Real natural vanilla imparts warm, woody notes that synthetic vanillin can never authentically duplicate.
examples.zh: 純天然頂級香草莢散發出溫潤溫暖的木質乳香，是人工合成香精香草粉永遠無法比擬的尊榮風味。

examples.en: After scraping out the tiny seeds, the spent vanilla pod was placed in a jar of raw sugar to create fragrant vanilla sugar.
examples.zh: 刮出細密香草籽後，將香草莢外皮埋入未精製細砂糖罐中封存，即可製成香氣逼人的天然香草糖。

words.definition: 70% 單一產區莊園級純黑可可膏

examples.en: Sourcing single-origin Ecuadorian dark cocoa beans yields fruity, floral notes with earthy depth.
examples.zh: 嚴選厄瓜多單一產區莊園級純黑可可豆，在烘焙後散發出迷人的熱帶果酸與優雅花香。

examples.en: Dusting the chocolate truffles with unsweetened Dutch-process cocoa powder provides a pleasantly bitter finish.
examples.zh: 在手工黑松露巧克力球表面薄薄滾上一層天然無糖荷蘭式純可可粉，帶來微苦回甘的優雅餘韻。

examples.en: Farmers ferment and dry the raw cocoa beans carefully to develop chocolate precursors before roasting.
examples.zh: 可可莊園農民在日照下細心翻拌發酵曬乾生可可豆，在烘烤前完整孕育出濃郁豐富的巧克力前驅風味。

words.definition: 法國 AOP 產區認證天然發酵奶油

examples.en: Using churned French AOP cultured butter gives puff pastry its signature nutty aroma and golden flakiness.
examples.zh: 選用正統法國 AOP 產區天然發酵奶油，賦予千層酥皮招牌的濃郁榛果香與金黃酥脆度。

examples.en: High fat content in European dry butter makes it pliable for rolling without breaking under cold temperatures.
examples.zh: 歐洲高乳脂天然發酵無水奶油具備優異的延展韌性，在低溫壓延時不易斷裂融化破皮。

examples.en: Slow churning fresh cream develops probiotic lactic aromas that elevate the flavor of plain brioche.
examples.zh: 慢速木桶攪乳發酵鮮奶油產生獨特乳酸微酸香氣，讓樸實無華的布里歐麵包風味昇華至新高度。

words.definition: 法國原裝進口 T65 傳統石磨小麥麵粉

examples.en: Stone-ground French T65 wheat flour preserves the nutrient-rich wheat germ, producing traditional chewy bread.
examples.zh: 採用法國傳統石磨研磨的 T65 小麥麵粉，完整保留小麥胚芽營養，烘烤出道地麥香四溢的歐包。

examples.en: The miller sifts the flour through silk screens to achieve exact mineral ash levels required by French standards.
examples.zh: 麵粉製粉師透過精密絲網篩選麥粉，精確控制法國法規所嚴格規範的小麥灰分礦物質含量標準。

examples.en: Protein quality in unbleached organic flour dictates how well your dough rises during baking.
examples.zh: 無漂白有機麵粉中優質蛋白質的品質與活性，直接決定了麵團在入爐高溫烘烤時的膨脹與支撐高度。

words.definition: 緩慢發酵之新鮮塊狀濕酵母；酵母

examples.en: Fresh compressed block yeast yields clean, dependable rising action without artificial chemical aftertastes.
examples.zh: 選用高品質新鮮塊狀濕酵母，能提供溫和穩定的發酵動力，完全無化學添加物的異味。

examples.en: Dissolving fresh yeast in lukewarm water wakes up the dormant single-celled fungal organisms.
examples.zh: 將新鮮濕酵母切碎溶解於微溫開水中輕柔攪勻，能溫柔喚醒處於休眠狀態的單細胞真菌酵母群。

examples.en: Instant dry yeast can be blended straight into dry flour, offering immense convenience for commercial kitchens.
examples.zh: 速發乾酵母能直接均勻倒入乾麵粉中混合攪拌，為大型中央烘焙廚房帶來極大的備料便利性。

words.definition: 高溫烘烤自然焦糖化香氣反應

examples.en: High baking temperatures induce deep sugar caramelization, turning cannelé exteriors into crunchy dark shells.
examples.zh: 二百二十度高溫烘烤引發高溫焦糖化反應，賦予可麗露外皮如蜂蠟般黑亮香脆的脆殼。

examples.en: Gentle caramelization of sweet yellow onions releases natural sweetness for savory quiches.
examples.zh: 耐心用中小火文火慢炒洋蔥丁使其充分焦糖化，能為法式鹹派內餡提煉出濃郁天然的甘甜底蘊。

examples.en: The pastry chef carefully monitored the bubbling sugar syrup to halt caramelization at amber stage.
examples.zh: 甜點名廚全神貫注緊盯著銅鍋中冒泡翻滾的融化糖漿，在轉為琥珀金黃的黃金瞬間離火冷卻。

words.definition: 梅納反應 (蛋白質與糖結合爆發麥香)

examples.en: The Maillard reaction between amino acids and reducing sugars creates hundreds of delicious roasted aroma molecules.
examples.zh: 麵團中的氨基酸與還原糖在高溫下發生神奇的梅納反應，瞬間爆發出數百種迷人麥香。

examples.en: Spraying alkaline lye water onto pretzels speeds up the Maillard reaction, yielding a deep mahogany color.
examples.zh: 在德國結麵包表面浸泡微量食用鹼水溶液，能劇烈加速高溫梅納反應，烤出深邃油亮的深紅褐色外皮。

examples.en: Understanding the chemistry of the Maillard reaction helps bakers dial in the ideal baking temperature.
examples.zh: 透徹理解梅納熱反應的生物化學機理，能引導專業烘焙師精準校準不同麵包的最佳烤溫與出爐時機。

words.definition: 外酥脆內濕潤軟 Q 之極致多重口感

examples.en: The hallmark of great pastry is contrast in texture—a crisp shell giving way to a meltingly soft filling.
examples.zh: 頂級法式甜點的最高靈魂在於口感對比——極致香脆的酥皮瞬間迎來入口即化、絲滑綿密的內餡。

examples.en: Adding toasted chopped pecans to the brownie batter introduces an appealing crumbly texture.
examples.zh: 在布朗尼蛋糕麵糊中拌入烘烤過的碧根果碎粒，能為濃郁綿密的蛋糕體增添驚豔的酥脆嚼感。

examples.en: Judges in baking competitions award top marks for desserts that master both crunchy and velvety textures.
examples.zh: 世界烘焙大賽國際評審在評分時，總是對能完美駕馭香脆酥皮與絲絨滑順雙重口感的作品給予最高分。

words.definition: 剛出爐撲鼻而來之誘人奶油麥香

examples.en: The warm, intoxicating buttery aroma floating from the oven makes it impossible to resist buying a loaf.
examples.zh: 剛出爐那一股溫暖迷人、撲鼻而來的發酵奶油麥香，讓人忍不住駐足買下一整條剛出爐的長棍。

examples.en: Roasted almonds and dark cocoa release an irresistible toasted aroma throughout the entire kitchen.
examples.zh: 現烤杏仁堅果與莊園級黑可可膏在烤箱中散發出令人難以抗拒的烘烤濃香，瀰漫整間甜點工坊。

examples.en: As the crust cools on wire racks, it emits a subtle wheaty aroma that signals flawless fermentation.
examples.zh: 當麵包出爐排放在冷卻鐵網架上呼吸散熱時，空氣中飄散著純淨迷人的天然麥香，印證了發酵的完滿。

words.definition: 世界麵包大賽冠軍大師之精湛手藝

examples.en: Taiwanese bakers conquered global podiums through relentless dedication and unmatched pastry craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 台灣烘焙名師（如吳寶春、王鵬傑）以日夜不懈的執著與爐火純青的烘焙工藝技術勇奪世界冠軍。

examples.en: Hand-laminating hundred-layer pastry requires exceptional physical stamina and artistic craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 純手工擀壓折疊超過百層的精緻千層酥皮，需要過人的體力耐力與近乎雕塑家的藝術工藝底蘊。

examples.en: True craftsmanship treats bread making not as a monotonous factory chore, but as living sculpture.
examples.zh: 真正登峰造極的職人手藝，從不將烘焙視為冰冷重複的工廠流水線，而是與有生命麵團的靈魂對話。

words.definition: 凌晨三點不辭辛勞揉麵之烘焙熱情

examples.en: Waking up at 3:00 AM every single morning is driven by an unquenchable passion for feeding people well.
examples.zh: 每天凌晨三點在寒冬中準時起床揉麵發酵，背後全憑一份熱愛土地、渴望為人們端出溫暖美味的熾熱熱情。

examples.en: Her burning passion for French pastry drove her to spend five years studying in top Paris academies.
examples.zh: 內心深處對法式精緻甜點的狂熱熱情，支撐著她遠赴法國巴黎頂尖廚藝名校苦學深造整整五年。

examples.en: Even after decades beside blazing ovens, the veteran baker’s eyes still sparkle with genuine passion.
examples.zh: 即便在熱浪翻騰的烤箱旁辛勤揮汗數十年，這位白髮蒼蒼的烘焙老匠人眼中依然閃耀著最初的純真熱情。

words.definition: 奢華精緻甜點帶來的極致誘惑享受

examples.en: Savoring a rich triple-chocolate truffle tart is an indulgence of pure culinary decadence.
examples.zh: 在悠閒午後細細品嚐一塊濃郁的三重黑巧克力松露塔，是一場無可救藥、令人感到無比幸福的奢華享受。

examples.en: Layered with gold leaf and Tahitian vanilla bean cream, the dessert reached the pinnacle of luxury and decadence.
examples.zh: 點綴著閃爍純金金箔並填滿大溪地香草卡士達醬，這款奢華甜點達到了極致奢華與銷魂享受的頂點。

examples.en: Once in a while, treating oneself to such buttery decadence is the sweetest reward for hard work.
examples.zh: 偶爾讓自己沉浸在如此濃郁罪惡的奶油甜點世界中，是對平日辛勤打拚生活最甜美的溫柔犒賞。

words.definition: 追求毫米級分毫不差的極致完美境界

examples.en: French pastry chefs pursue aesthetic perfection, ensuring every chocolate curl sits at a precise angle.
examples.zh: 法式頂級甜點大師一生執著追求極致完美，確保每一片巧克力裝飾羽毛皆以分毫不差的優雅角度擺放。

examples.en: Achieving crusty sourdough perfection requires dialing in dough temperature, room humidity, and steam volume.
examples.zh: 想要烤出外脆內潤的完美極致酸種麵包，必須嚴格校準麵團出缸溫度、室內濕度與烤箱蒸氣量。

examples.en: Striving for perfection means discarding any batch that fails to meet stringent quality standards.
examples.zh: 對極致完美的偏執追求，意味著只要任何一爐出爐成色未達嚴格標準，烘焙大師寧可忍痛整批銷毀。

words.definition: 咬下一口現烤熱騰甜點的心靈至福

examples.en: A warm butter croissant paired with hot espresso on a quiet Sunday morning offers pure gastronomic bliss.
examples.zh: 在悠閒的週日清晨，一塊剛出爐香酥可頌搭配一杯香濃義式濃縮咖啡，帶來舌尖與心靈深處最純粹的美食至福。

examples.en: The euphoric aroma of caramel and melted chocolate wrapping around the dining room was total bliss.
examples.zh: 焦糖的微甜苦香與融化巧克力的濃郁氣息在溫馨餐廳中瀰漫環繞，讓人感到身心放鬆的無比幸福。

examples.en: Taking the first crispy bite of a hot strawberry puff brought a smile of serene bliss to her face.
examples.zh: 輕輕咬下第一口剛出爐、溫熱酥脆的現烤草莓泡芙，她臉上不禁洋溢起發自內心的安詳至福微笑。
